story: The Felice Brothers are a Catskills folk-rock band of accordions, fiddles and Dylan-esque storytelling, led by the brothers Ian and James. Celebration, Florida, their fourth album and first for Fat Possum, was recorded in the old high school in Beacon, New York and came out in May 2011. They played Pickathon in 2013. Life in the Dark came on Yep Roc in 2016 and From Dreams to Dust in 2021, and in summer 2026 they toured Europe and North America, with Newport Folk Festival and U.K. dates.
artist_reel_line: In summer 2026 they played Newport Folk Festival and U.K. dates.

intro: A North Carolina songwriter of soulful country-folk.
story: Tift Merritt is a North Carolina songwriter who started out in Chapel Hill and Raleigh bands, and her warm, soulful country-folk came to Pickathon in 2013. Tambourine, in 2004, was nominated for a Grammy for Best Country Album and for the Americana Music Association's Album of the Year. Traveling Alone, her first for Yep Roc, came out in October 2012 with Andrew Bird and Marc Ribot as guests, and she said its title speaks to the value of being self-sustaining. Stitch of the World followed in 2017, and in 2025 and 2026 she opened her vaults with kitchen sessions and catalog reissues.
artist_reel_line: In 2025 and 2026 she released archival and live-in-the-kitchen singles and reissues.
